name: Noob Bee
tagline: 1 comment = 1 level up. Teach the noob bee anything.

episodes.title: Meet the noob
episodes.summary: He can't even jump a wall. Every comment teaches him one thing: first lesson, walking.

episodes.title: Wall jump unlocked
episodes.summary: Wall jumps, a skateboard and a very questionable moonwalk. The noob is now a Rookie.

episodes.title: Is he still a noob?
episodes.summary: Over 250 levels: breakdance, karate, time travel. Tomorrow he goes Expert — what should he learn next?
